summary: The diff implements REQ-1 (admin credential reset) and REQ-3 (forgot password UI), but is missing REQ-2 (persistent session management) and REQ-4 (automatic customer notifications). No hallucinated features detected.

missing_requirements.requirement: Fix admin session timeout by implementing persistent session management. Ensure the admin stays logged in during the working session without being repeatedly logged out.
missing_requirements.reason: No evidence of session persistence implementation in backend/main.mo. The authentication function grants admin role but does not implement session timeout fixes, persistent session storage, or mechanisms to maintain session across page refreshes.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement automatic customer notifications when the admin changes an order status (e.g., to 'Out for Delivery'). Notifications should be sent via the app or WhatsApp.
missing_requirements.reason: No notification system implementation found in the diff. The backend (main.mo) shows order status types but no notification logic. The frontend file summaries mention order status update mutations (useConfirmOrder, useMarkAsPacked, etc.) but no notification sending mechanism is evident.
